title: God is There
verse: For where two or three are assembled in my name, I am there among them.
observation: God is omnipresent. This means God stands outside of all things, but all things exist within Him. This means there is no place where God is not also present. While that can be a difficult concept to get our minds to comprehend, the bottom line is the same. There is nowhere that God is not present. This is helpful, because we can sometimes feel as though God is far away. This is not possible. So, no matter where you are and no matter who is with you, God is also there.
application: Take time to think about God always being close in all seasons of life.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for never letting us walk through a moment alone.
